answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1842 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mesa. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the ember queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. The nadir index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 289 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
